name: friday-night-poker
description: Poker night bookkeeping app — React + Express + SQLite

scripts.build: yarn workspace @fnp/shared build && yarn workspace client build
scripts.dev: yarn workspace @fnp/shared build && concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "yarn workspace server dev" "yarn workspace client dev"
scripts.type-check: yarn workspace @fnp/shared build && yarn workspaces run type-check
